brief: EMS brings electronics, clothing, pharmacy and supershop workflows into one practical, dependable retail platform. The approved provider line is Powered by Dexter Studio and stays separate from the logo lockup.
criteria: Selected direction B — Shared Core. The mark should remain legible at small icon sizes, work in one colour and reverse cleanly, and avoid literal storefront imagery.

concepts.name: Shared Core
concepts.idea: Four modular corner forms link diagonally into one shared core, joining distinct shop workflows under one platform.
rationale: The four outer modules echo EMS's different shop types; the central hub signals a shared operational core.
Rounded outer corners and diagonal links soften the first sketch's focus-frame reading.
A two-colour teal palette stays practical in print, while one-colour and reverse versions preserve the form.

recommendation: The Shared Core mark is the approved identity. Use the full-colour horizontal lockup on light surfaces, the reverse lockup on dark surfaces, and the small-size cut for favicons and app icons.
next_steps: Apply the included Postgres or D1 migration to update legacy stored brand defaults.
Run the final browser and device verification before deployment.
